text: Protocol declared before simulated outcomes: tools/scenarios/corrected-gls/protocol.json, declaration receipt docs/verification/corrected-gls-qualification-20261008/protocol-declaration.json. Six matched Gaussian AR(1)/AR(2) cells, unequal runs 96/144, low/high nuisance load, run/global/voxelwise pooling and censor resets. Paired known-phi/raw/corrected public fits; independent seed domains and budgets 16 pilot / 64 screen / 2048 confirmation per cell. Pilot/screen are not scientific admission. Confirmation requires all retained corrected and known-phi results, AR recovery/whiteness limits, exact 90% CP count equivalence at nominal alpha .05 and coverage .95, and 90% bootstrap/mean-bias equivalence intervals. No case/seed/criterion changes after outcomes. The historical broader calibration campaign remains untouched.
